name: Speed Metal Vimana
source: Pouring rain. Unpaid bills. A clandestine drug war. The order comes in, the car engine roars. The mission starts. Follow freelance mercenaries Mars and Shiva on their latest mission into the depths of the city.  Will they survive? Can they survive? Should they survive? The only way to know is to hunker down and start playing.
